text:
Maya: Heads-up — quick sync needed on launch boundary. Customer Bankly is pushing for tenant-level audit logs for the GA pilot. We need to decide whether to put audit logs in the public-launch MVP or defer full visibility to v1. Short takes and tradeoffs please.
Eli: I'm leaning defer to v1 unless a contractual requirement forces it into MVP. Audit UI + query is infra-heavy.
Priya: Security perspective: ACME is fine with request-on-demand logs, Bankly explicitly asked for audit trails. Contract notes: ACME = optional, Bankly = must-have for pilot. We should map customer lanes before finalizing.
Sam: Engineering estimate: basic append-only export to S3 + KMS = ~3w. Full tenant-level searchable UI + RBAC + query infra = ~6w. Proposed compromise: ship S3 export in MVP, then UI/search in v1.
Maya: :thinking_face: Good start. Does S3 export satisfy Bankly's acceptance criteria? @Jun — any flexibility on their side?
Jun: Bankly prefers UI but can accept S3 export + parsing + weekly delivery script as a pilot concession. They'll want onboarding docs and a signed SLA for retention.
Priya: From compliance: S3 export + server-side KMS encryption + signed URLs + retention policy meets baseline. We'll need a retention/erasure policy doc and security review before GA.
Sam: Plan proposal: MVP = S3 export (server batching, KMS, signed URLs) + customer onboarding script. v1 = UI with query, retention controls, RBAC. I'll own infra work. Config will be gated behind `tenant.audit.s3.enabled`.
Sam: ```
MVP deliverables:
- server log export to S3 (batched)
- KMS integration + encryption at rest
- signed, time-limited download URLs
- onboarding script + parsing templates for customers
- docs and acceptance test for Bankly
```
Maya: Timeline impact: With current sprint load, MVP + docs puts us ~3w of work -> effectively shifts public-launch by one sprint. Options: (a) keep existing launch date and drop noncritical perf profiling/features, (b) delay launch one sprint to include proper audit MVP. Which do we prefer?
Priya: Don't drop profiling — it's important for our latency SLO and for customers running at scale. Recommend option (b) delay one sprint.
Eli: Agree with Priya. Delay one sprint. Also propose adding a low-cost fallback logging mode for spikes so we don't lose critical events under load.
Jun: I can negotiate with Bankly to accept S3 export + weekly delivery script for the pilot and ask them to wait for the UI in v1. I'll confirm by EOD.
Maya: :thumbsup: Decision: delay launch by 1 sprint; include S3 export in MVP; owner Sam; security signoff Priya; Jun to confirm Bankly acceptance. Action items: Sam open infra ticket + PR, Priya draft retention policy, Jun confirm with Bankly, Maya will update roadmap and launch doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/roadmap/public-launch-2026
ProductBot: Roadmap updated — milestone "public-launch-2026" shifted +1 sprint (new target: 2026-05-12).
Jun: Confirmed with Bankly — they'll accept S3 export + onboarding script for the pilot. They'll sign the LOI. :party_parrot:
Maya: Thanks team. I'll update the release notes and send a short customer-facing note for Bankly and ACME.
Sam: Opening infra ticket now: `INFRA-1298` and draft PR for `tenant.audit.s3.enabled`. Will tag Priya for review.
Priya: I'll start the compliance doc and ping legal about retention language.
Maya: Great — let's re-check in tomorrow morning standup for any blockers.
